interpretation: The default eagle and horse cases skip root CG at the existing initial-residual threshold, so none of these solvers is invoked. Tightening the oracle and GPU cg_accuracy together to 1e-8 exercises the eight-row root. FSAI halves CG iterations and reduces the small-fixture median by about 1.6 ms; cuDSS is slower when factorization setup is included. No production default is changed.
